# PayPal

Payments · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**PayPal publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Both indexed, plus PayPal's agent-toolkit SDK and its older paypal-mcp-server. Both of those can process payments and refunds.

## What to use

### From PayPal

- **[PayPal MCP Server](../../skills/paypal-mcp-server/README.md)** — MCP server · Can move money; Changes records without asking first · needs PayPal access token · [source](https://github.com/paypal/paypal-mcp-server/tree/main)
  PayPal's MCP server: invoices, orders, payments, refunds, disputes, subscriptions, products and shipment tracking.
- **[paypal-best-practices](../../skills/paypal-best-practices/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs integration intent · [source](https://github.com/paypal/AI-Toolkit/tree/main/skills/paypal-best-practices)
  PayPal integration guidance, code examples, and best practices.
- **[paypal-routing](../../skills/paypal-routing/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs developer intent · [source](https://github.com/paypal/AI-Toolkit/tree/main/skills/paypal-routing)
  PayPal payments, subscriptions, checkout, invoices, disputes, webhooks, BNPL, Venmo, SDK, v5, v6, Fastlane, Braintree Fastlane, braintree-web, accelerated guest checkout.
- **[PayPal Agent Toolkit](../../skills/paypal-agent-toolkit/README.md)** — Developer toolkit · Can move money; Changes records without asking first · needs PayPal access token · [source](https://github.com/paypal/agent-toolkit/tree/main)
  PayPal's SDK for agent frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, MCP): invoices, orders, payments, refunds, subscriptions, products and shipment tracking as callable tools.

## Mosofin connection status

How far Mosofin's own connector to this platform has got. This is separate from the tools above.

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | roadmap — Committed — registration runbook written |
| Sign-in | Three-legged OAuth — the merchant clicks Approve. A real connector. |
| Account unit | Merchant — payer_id |
| Token | 8 h access + refresh (REFRESH) |
| Lead time | None — self-serve |
| Settlement data | yes |

**What to watch:** Log in with PayPal, not Partner Referrals — the latter creates new seller accounts. Transaction Search must be ticked or the scope is silently absent from the granted token.
